claims.claim: The CNIL fined Free Mobile and Free €42 million in total.
claims.quote: une amende administrative de 27 millions d'euros à l'encontre de la société FREE MOBILE et de 15 millions d'euros à l'encontre de la société FREE

claims.claim: The breach concerns more than 24 million subscriber contracts.
claims.quote: La violation concerne les données de plus de 24 millions de contrats d'abonnés

claims.claim: The CNIL found a breach of article 34 because the email to subscribers was incomplete.
claims.quote: le courriel adressé aux personnes concernées ne contenait pas l'ensemble des informations requises par l'article 34 du RGPD

claims.claim: The leak exposes victims to fraudulent direct debits.
claims.quote: dont plusieurs font état de tentatives d'hameçonnage
claims.note: The decision mentions phishing attempts reported in complaints, not fraudulent direct debits.

claims.claim: All 24 million subscribers had their IBAN leaked.
claims.note: The decision says only some contracts contained an IBAN.

claims.claim: Opt-in rate of 0.5% / 2% / 5% and €150 per person.
claims.note: Labelled as an assumption in the pitch; not verified.

scores.reason: The CNIL found breaches of articles 32 and 34; appeal status is unknown.
scores.quote: Les sociétés n'ont pas mis en œuvre les mesures techniques et organisationnelles appropriées

scores.reason: IBANs were leaked for part of the group; the rest is identity and contact data only.
scores.quote: pour une partie des abonnés, l'IBAN

scores.reason: More than 24 million contracts, though the number of distinct persons is not stated.
scores.quote: plus de 24 millions de contrats d'abonnés

scores.reason: Over 2,500 complaints, several reporting phishing; no finding that data was published or sold.
scores.quote: la CNIL a reçu plus de 2 500 plaintes de personnes concernées

scores.reason: The CNIL found a breach of article 34.
scores.quote: ne contenait pas l'ensemble des informations requises par l'article 34 du RGPD

scores.reason: Private telecommunications operators; revenue not stated in the decision.
scores.quote: Les sociétés FREE MOBILE et FREE sont des opérateurs de communications électroniques

scores.reason: Treating contracts as persons and applying the IBAN rate to the whole group may be aggressive.

red_flags: Appeal status before the Conseil d'État is not stated in the decision.
Group size is given in contracts, not persons.
Check the limitation period for compensation claims.
Confirm the association meets the standing requirements for an action de groupe.
Missing information: defendant revenue; whether data was published or sold.
summary: The CNIL decision establishes security and notification failures by a solvent private defendant affecting a very large group. Harm evidence is limited to complaints and phishing reports, and the recovery estimate depends on aggressive assumptions about group size and compensation.
